children.name: Aulacomnium androgynum
children.description: Aulacomnium androgynum, the bud-headed groovemoss, is a species of moss with a discontinuous circumboreal distribution in Eurasia and North America.

children.name: Aulacomnium heterostichum
children.description: Aulacomnium heterostichum (synonym Arrhenopterum heterostichum), commonly called goose-egg moss or star moss, is a species of moss in the family Aulacomniaceae.

children.name: Aulacomnium palustre
children.description: Aulacomnium palustre, the bog groove-moss or ribbed bog moss, is a moss that is nearly cosmopolitan in distribution.

children.name: Aulacomnium turgidum
children.description: Aulacomnium turgidum, commonly called swollen thread-moss or mountain groove-moss, is a species of moss in the family Aulacomniaceae.

children.name: Mesochaete undulata
children.description: Mesochaete undulata is a moss found in Australia and Lord Howe Island.
